app.name: TeamTown
app.worldLabel: Isometric office. The people list on the left shows everyone on this floor.

auth.intro: Sign in with your company account to walk into the office.

office.loadError: The office could not be loaded. Please try again in a moment.
office.walkHint: Click a tile or use WASD / arrow keys to walk.

audioCheck.title: Quick sound check
audioCheck.intro: Others hear you as soon as you walk up to them. Let's make sure your microphone and speakers work.
audioCheck.speakNow: Say something: the bar should move.
audioCheck.denied: We couldn't access your microphone. You can still listen and switch it on later.

media.microphoneShortcut: Switch the microphone on or off (M)

conversation.title: Conversation
conversation.nowLocked: Your conversation is now private. Nobody new can join.

room.waiting: You knocked on {{room}}. Waiting for an answer…
room.result_admitted: You may come in. Walking in…
room.result_declined: Not right now. Try again later.

call.dialogIntro: Everyone who is online right now.
call.noOne: Nobody else is online right now.
call.incomingGroup: {{name}} invites you to a call with {{others}}.
call.full: A call can have up to 8 people.
call.failed: The call could not be started. Please try again.

screen.takenOver: {{name}} is sharing now, so your share stopped.

log.startIntro: Everyone in the room is asked first. Stored are the title, who took part, and start and end time. Nothing else, no audio.
log.title: Title
log.consentWithTitle: “{{title}}” is logged. If you join, the title, your name and the start and end time of the meeting are stored.
log.consentWithoutTitle: The meeting in {{room}} is logged. If you join, the title, your name and the start and end time of the meeting are stored.
log.myMeetingsIntro: Logged meetings you took part in. They are deleted automatically after the retention period.
log.none: You haven't taken part in a logged meeting yet.
log.loadError: Your meetings could not be loaded. Please try again.

chat.newChannelIntro: Everyone can find a public channel. A private one only its members see; you invite them.
chat.kindHint_public: Everyone can find and join it.
chat.browseIntro: All public channels. Join one to write in it.
chat.archivedHint: Archived: you can read it, but nobody can write here.
chat.newMessageIntro: Pick up to 7 people. If you already have a conversation with exactly them, it opens.
chat.pickedAll_one: That's everyone who still fits: {{count}} more person.
chat.pickedAll_other: That's everyone who still fits: {{count}} more people.
chat.inviteIntro: They see the channel and its history.
chat.addPeopleIntro: They see the conversation and its history. Up to 8 people in total.
chat.loadError: The chat could not be loaded. Please try again in a moment.
chat.composerHint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line. **bold**, _italic_, `code`, - lists.

error.generic: That didn't work. Please try again.
error.invalid-request: That didn't work. Please try again.
error.invalid-channel-name: Channel names have 1 to 40 characters: lowercase letters, digits, - and _.
error.channel-name-taken: There's already a channel with this name.
error.channel-archived: This channel is archived. Nobody can write in it.
error.not-channel-creator: Only the person who created the channel can do this.
error.not-message-author: You can only change your own messages.
error.invalid-message: Messages can't be empty and have at most 4,000 characters.
error.direct-message-too-large: A conversation has at most 8 people. For more, create a private channel.
error.unknown-person: Someone you picked is no longer here.
